# geladen.ch ballistics

> A free, client-side external ballistics suite for small-arms shooters: trajectory tables (3DOF/4DOF), hit-probability analysis, ballistic-coefficient tools, a Cd-Mach curve builder, a rifle-precision analyzer, and a field range solver. Everything runs in the browser — no accounts, no server of ours, no data ever collected by us. An optional online-weather feature (off by default) contacts public weather services directly from the device when the user switches it on. Installs offline as a PWA on desktop and mobile. Open source under AGPL-3.0-or-later. Available in English, French, Russian, German, and Italian.

## Docs

- [Live app](https://bc.geladen.ch/): the application itself.
- [About / project background](https://bc.geladen.ch/about/): what the app is, what each tool does, license and privacy — also at /about/fr/, /about/de/, /about/it/, /about/ru/.
- [Source code](https://github.com/geladen-ch/ballistic-tools): full source, issue tracker, license text.

## Notes

- The app is a single-page client-side application (hash-based routing, no build step). A crawler that does not execute JavaScript will only see the About pages linked above, not the app's internal views.
- No user accounts, no telemetry, no server-side component of any kind — all computation happens in the visitor's own browser. The optional online-weather feature (off by default) makes the visitor's browser contact public weather services (Iowa Environmental Mesonet, MeteoSwiss, GeoSphere Austria, Bright Sky, DMI, Environment Canada) directly; nothing goes through geladen.ch.
